abort.already_configured: This June oven is already configured.
abort.pairing_lost: The pairing session was lost. Start again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the oven's server. Check the oven host, certificate settings, and Home Assistant's network connection, then try again.
error.invalid_ca_cert: The CA certificate is not a valid PEM certificate.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address, optionally with a port or an http:// or https:// prefix, and nothing else.
error.not_paired_yet: The oven has not finished pairing. Enter the code on the oven, wait a few seconds, and try again.
error.pairing_failed: The oven rejected or could not finish pairing. Confirm it is idle, closed, online, and try again.

pair.description: On the oven, open **Connect** and enter **{code}**. Wait for the oven to finish, then select Submit.
pair.title: Pair the oven

data_description.ca_cert: Only applies to a custom host. Paste your home's CA certificate so Home Assistant trusts the oven's certificate. Leave empty to use the system's trusted certificates.
data_description.host: Leave empty to use June's cloud (api.junelife.com and messaging.junelife.com). For a Project July oven, enter its hostname or IP address, such as 192.168.1.50 or june.local. Add :port or an http:// or https:// prefix if needed; HTTPS is assumed.
data_description.verify_ssl: Only applies to a custom host. Turn off to accept the oven's certificate without checking it.

user.description: Home Assistant will create a private companion identity and pair directly with the oven. No June account login is needed.
user.title: Set up June Oven
